digest.component_or_area: CLI-served author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: Clients running rebar CLI without a rebar checkout encounter dead links in packaged author guides because internal cross-references use consumer-relative paths instead of resolvable URLs or CLI commands.

The commit-trailer format specification (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in verify-commit-ticket help, with no visible discovery path from explain or other entry points.
Packaged guides in src/rebar/_guides/ reference repo-only docs, sibling guides, and contributing files using relative paths that do not resolve for repo-less consumers.
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the list of available guides (plan, review) and does not include new guides, causing documentation drift.
All dangling guide references must be converted to either hosted https URLs (for repo docs) or rebar explain <topic> invocations (for packaged sibling guides) to maintain consistency.
